setBody.groovy:
import groovy.json.JsonOutput import java.time.LocalDateTime import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
def random = new Random() def atms = [ [id:'ATM-001', tid:'TID001', branch:'Addis Ababa Main Branch'], [id:'ATM-002', tid:'TID002', branch:'Bole International Branch'], [id:'ATM-003', tid:'TID003', branch:'Merkato Branch'], [id:'ATM-004', tid:'TID004', branch:'Hawassa Branch'], [id:'ATM-005', tid:'TID005', branch:'Dire Dawa Branch'] ] def atm = atms[random.nextInt(atms.size())]
def mtis = ['0200','0210','0400','0420'] def mti = mtis[random.nextInt(mtis.size())]
def processingCodes = [ '012000':'WITHDRAWAL', '310000':'BALANCE_INQ', '400000':'TRANSFER', '050000':'MINI_STATEMENT' ] def pcEntry = processingCodes .entrySet().toList() def pc = pcEntry[ random.nextInt(pcEntry.size())]
def amounts = [ 100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000] def amount = amounts[ random.nextInt(amounts.size())]
def cards = [ '4000000000001234', '4000000000005678', '5200000000009012', '4000000000003456', '5200000000007890' ] def card = cards[ random.nextInt(cards.size())] def maskedCard = card.take(4) + '************' + card.takeLast(4)
def responseCodes = [ '00':'APPROVED', '51':'DECLINED', '05':'DECLINED', '54':'DECLINED', '91':'TIMEOUT', '96':'ERROR' ] def weights = [ '00','00','00','00', '00','00','00','00','00', '51','05','54','91','96'] def rcKey = weights[ random.nextInt(weights.size())] def rcVal = responseCodes[rcKey]
def now = LocalDateTime.now() def fmt = DateTimeFormatter .ofPattern('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
def msg = [ iso_mti: mti, iso_processing_code: pc.key, iso_stan: String.format( '%06d', random.nextInt(999999)), atm_id: atm.id, terminal_id: atm.tid, branch: atm.branch, txn_type: pc.value, card_pan: card, card_masked: maskedCard, amount: (pc.value == 'WITHDRAWAL' || pc.value == 'TRANSFER') ? amount : null, currency: 'ETB', response_code: rcKey, status: rcVal, auth_code: rcVal == 'APPROVED' ? String.format('%06d', random.nextInt(999999)) : null, timestamp: now.format(fmt), source: 'ISO8583' ]
JsonOutput.toJson(msg)
